label: General
title: Project — General
subtitle: Basic project metadata such as the title and timestamps.
description: The General tab inside project settings shows information about the project itself. The title is the only editable field; timestamps are read-only.

settings.name: Project Title
settings.description: The name shown in the sidebar and project header. InnoviumAI can also auto-generate a title from the conversation content via the context menu.

settings.name: Created At
settings.description: Read-only timestamp of when the project was first created.

settings.name: Last Updated
settings.description: Read-only timestamp of the most recent change to the project.

mediaCaption: Project settings General tab showing the title field and read-only timestamp fields
